title: Microsoft Purview: scan existing SharePoint and OneDrive files for sensitive information (GCC, GCC High, DoD)
summary: Hold: the briefing overstates the protection gap for older files and says cancelled scans are not billed without supporting documentation. Existing classifications can still support policy matches, and Microsoft describes skipped items reducing charges rather than cancellation making an entire scan free.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans to let administrators scan existing files at rest in SharePoint or OneDrive for Business for sensitive data.
claims.quote: This new capability will enable admins to scan existing files at rest in SharePoint or OneDrive for business for sensitive data.
